content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 10th standard pass from a school situated in Chhattisgarh or Madhya Pradesh; 5th standard pass for Scheduled Tribe candidates; 5th standard pass for candidates belonging to Naxal-affected families or residing in relief camps Age limit: 18 to 28 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC Up to 5 years, Local female candidates of Sukma district Up to 10 years Other conditions: Must meet physical measurement and medical standards. Desirable: Heavy motor vehicle driving licence: 5 bonus marks NCC C or NSS C certificate: 5 bonus marks Knowledge of the local dialect of the district: 20 bonus marks

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for SP Sukma Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who are not local residents of Sukma district Physically disabled candidates Candidates with knock-knee or flat foot Candidates with any eye disease Disqualification follows paragraph 09 of notification ESTB-1/762/2025-HOME SECTION dated 31.08.2026

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Government-approved Pay Matrix Level-4 and allowances payable from time to time; no rupee amount is printed.

content_sections.heading: How Will SP Sukma Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document Verification Physical Measurements Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Written Examination Interview Bonus Marks Evaluation Physical Efficiency Test consists of long jump, high jump, shot put, 100 meters run, and 800 meters run (20 marks each, total 100 marks). Written exam consists of 50 objective questions covering General Knowledge, reasoning, local geography, culture, and arithmetic. Interview carries a maximum of 20 marks.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SP Sukma Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SP Sukma Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 375 vacancies for Bastar Fighter Constable.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SP Sukma Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Attached to the notification PDF) and send it to Office of the Superintendent of Police District Sukma, Composite Building, Kumhararas, Sukma, Chhattisgarh, PIN- 494111, by registered post / speed post or by hand, to reach by 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 28 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC Up to 5 years, Local female candidates of Sukma district Up to 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-4 Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10th pass from a school in Chhattisgarh/Madhya Pradesh, or 5th pass for Scheduled Tribes and affected families.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must meet physical measurement and medical standards.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not local residents of Sukma district. Physically disabled candidates. Candidates with knock-knee or flat foot. Candidates with any eye disease.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document Verification. Physical Measurements. Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Written Examination.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Sukma.
